notes.title: Game Announcement, Modern Pink Elf RPG!!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!! Happy 2024!! ːkarrynComfyː

We're happy to announce that we are publishing a new eroge for 2024!! Developed by the talented Sensouya-san (Warshop) and localized by our friends at Cursed Atelier, we're proud to bring you:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020227/3d92962506b8814eeacd72389553acde631fe462.png[/img] 

[h1]Modern Pink Elf RPG![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745710/Modern_Pink_Elf_RPG

It's a well done simple eroge RPG with no combat, no leveling. You play as the very pretty Cleome, an pink haired elf that gets teleported to an alternative world in the modern age. And you know what they say about pink hair animes.

Featuring over 50 unique CGs and over 60 scenes, with the 3 main rival interests each getting over 12 escalating scenes. Modern Elf is what you go to when you don't want or need gameplay in your eroge, and you just want to see a big titty elf get porked silly for a few hours. The chicken soup of eroge. No worlds to save, no gods to slay, no family to avenge. Just an elf with a smartphone with a light premise of earning money to go back to her home world and using that to end up having a lot of sexual encounters.

Modern Pink Elf RPG has been a localization work in progress for over a year by our friends at Cursed Atelier, and they are also currently developing their own game so go check out! It's an eroge with gameplay, so when you're done playing Modern Pink Elf RPG and need something more heavy, maybe you go check out their Voidbound, or vice verse when you're done playing something heavy and need a light eroge, come check our Modern Pink Elf RPG!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/

And of course, none of this would've been possible without the talented developer that has been very kind and patience, Sensouya-san (Warshop). ːtonkinBulliedːːlovewaveː

https://twitter.com/enwEJLMiuUIHies

They recently two months ago also released a new eroge in Japanese called NTR Knight, so if you know Japanese definitely go take a look at it if you haven't!

https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01095162.html
https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/4764

Modern Pink Elf RPG will be releasing on February 2nd, 11am PST/1pm EST, and in English, Japanese, SChinese and TChinese!!! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745710/Modern_Pink_Elf_RPG

Go wishlist it, tell your friends to wishlist it, and tell them to tell their friends to wishlist it!! And we'll see you in February!!

As always, stay up to date by following us on our Discord and Twitter accounts!

Discord: https://discord.gg/5qyyGP258x
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Remtairy

notes.title: v1.2m Changelog: 'No, Meltys Quest does not contain a trojan' Edition
notes.content:
It has been brought to my attention thanks to the reports of our fans, that Bitdefender has falsely flagged one of the game scripts as a trojan. Meltys does not like Trojans of any kind, so you can rest assured that there are none in this game. :cenus:

For more details, please read this forum post: https://steamcommunity.com/app/723090/discussions/0/1745605598722171831/

As for what changed in v1.2m:

The achievement condition for
[list]
[*] The Supreme Kogal 世界最強のギャル♥
[/list]
has been fixed in the Japanese version.

And the achievement conditions for
[list]
[*] The Love Doctor 用爱治愈一切
[*] Mano a Mano 格斗家的对决
[*] The Venus Flytrap 自取灭亡
[*] The Supreme Kogal 超级辣妹
[*] Why not I suppose. 节约光荣，浪费可耻
[/list]
has been fixed in the Chinese version.

Meltys Quest is still on sale for the next 36 hours so tell your neighbors across the street: Meltys Quest doesn't have Trojans but it does now have a Chinese localization! :meltys:

notes.title: Version 1.2 Changelog and Special Sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30885323/86a8a8d97de87d632732b39d4fad007bd7fa413b.png[/img]

Today, I’m proud to announce that with Steam’s new Adult Only policy, today’s v1.2 update to Meltys Quest will make it completely UNCENSORED on Steam without any external modifications! Meltys is now looking as bangin’ as ever!

Meltys Quest was the first eroge where an indie Japanese developer and an indie American developer worked together to bring a high quality product simultaneously to both the Japanese and English markets at the same time. It also heralded the beginning of the standard of quality on Steam being raised for English localizations of indie Japanese eroges. There are plenty of talented indie Japanese eroge developers out there that deserve much, much more than their games being sold for pennies on Steam with a machine translation and broken scripts. The users on Steam also deserve better for their precious time and hard earned money! :meltys:

Just as Meltys Quest heralded a new age of cooperation and awareness with Japanese indie eroge developers, we hope to herald another new age of uncensored Japanese eroge onto Steam. To celebrate this joyous occasion, Meltys Quest will be on sale from September 12 to September 23 for 30% off!

The sale starts tomorrow, but the uncensor update will be live today! So if you’re impatient or want to support the cause, you’re more than welcome to purchase Meltys Quest today for yourself or for someone you know! :lovewave:

If you’ve already brought Meltys Quest, then help spread the word and tell your friends and family: "The new age of uncensored eroges on Steam has just began!!! Viva La Eroge!!" :lovewave::meltys:

(Here's 3 samples of the many beautiful CGs now available uncensored with the v1.2 patch, very NSFW https://twitter.com/Remtairy/status/1039615588971241474 )

notes.title: Version 1.11b Changelog
notes.content:
There were a lot of small incremental fixes since version 1.10 was released last month, so here's a list of the changes for prosperity. :tonkin:

[list]
    [*]Fixed a curious case of invisible wall-ism in front of the bridge in the new postgame area.
    [*]Translated the description for the Moo Moo Leotard into English. ːsteamfacepalmː
    [*]Fixed a certain Tentacle Monster's skill that is so spectacular for our human minds that it sometimes crashes the game.
[*]Fixed the CG of an outdoor scene in CG Mode displaying the wrong image set.
[*]Added more checks into the achievement triggering process so that you shouldn't permanently miss getting a Steam achievement if you lost connection with Steam.
[*]Fixed the Monsterpedia text getting cut off for several Monsters.
[*]Nerfed D.M.U.'s damage, debuffs and status resistance.
[*]Fixed a display bug with Meltys not getting visibly pregnant when she gets pregnant while wearing the Moo Moo Leotard. 
[*]Fixed the CG Mode of Shadow - Defeat scene.
[*]Minor text fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10 Changelog and Week-Long Sale
notes.content:
Surprise! Meltys Quest has been updated to version 1.10 and with it comes a free content update!

[list]
    [*]A few new sidequests!
    [*]More scenes!
[*]A new costume!
    [*]Eight new achievements!
[*]A new challenge dungeon and the level cap is raised to 80!
[*]Street Vendor Tart is now stocked with a new item that allows you to view scenes you've already experienced!
[*]And various bug and image fixes!
[/list] 

All of the new contents can only be accessed post-game during Ending Y, which requires the castle to be re-built. To find where the new content begins, make sure you've finished the sidequest related to a certain struggling artist and find him in your castle!

To celebrate the new update, Meltys Quest will be on sale all week long for 25% off!
:meltys: Happy questing! :cenus:

notes.content:
